paragraphs.en: In an era where our lives are flooded with digital {broadcasts} of content, our {possession} of smartphones and social media accounts has transformed from tools of {convenience} into sources of anxiety.Some people are pushed to {reply} to messages, as if they were {servants} to their {devices} .The goal of this book is to make the case for digital {minimalism} , including a {detailed} exploration of what it asks and {why} it works, and {then} to teach you how to adopt this philosophy if you decide it's right for you.
paragraphs.cn: 在一个生活被各种数字内容 <u> 传 </u> <u> 播 </u> 所淹没的时代，我们 <u> 拥有 </u> 的智能手机和社交媒体账户已经从 <u> 便利 </u> 的工具变成了焦虑的源头。有些人被迫 <u> 回复 </u> 信息，仿佛成了自己 <u> 设备 </u> 的 <u> 仆人 </u> 。本书的目的是阐述支持数字 <u> 极简主义 </u> 的理由，包括 <u> 详细 </u> 探讨它的要求以及它 <u> 为何 </u> 有效， <u> 然后 </u> 如果你认定这一理念适合你，它还将指导你如何运用这种理念。

paragraphs.en: To do so, I divided the book into two parts.In part one, I describe the philosophical {foundations} of digital minimalism, starting with an {examination} of the forces that are making so many people's digital lives {increasingly} intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
paragraphs.cn: 为此，我将本书分为两个部分。在第一部分中，我描述了数字极简主义的哲学 <u> 基础 </u> ，首先 <u> 剖析 </u> 了让许多人的数字生活变得 <u> 愈发 </u> 难以忍受的因素，继而详细讨论了数字极简主义这一理念。

paragraphs.en: Part one {concludes} by {introducing} my suggested {method} for adopting this philosophy: the digital {declutter} .This approach is similar to sending a {parcel} of one's digital {dependencies} into {storage} .It requires us to intentionally ( (有意地) ) {delete} unnecessary digital applications and {files} we don't need to access.During this process, we step away from {optional} online {activities} for thirty days, creating an {empty} space that allows for deeper concentration.At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of {carefully} chosen online activities that you believe will provide {massive} benefits to the things you value.
paragraphs.cn: 在第一部分的 <u> 结尾介绍 </u> 了我建议采用这一理念的 <u> 方法 </u> ：数字 <u> 清理 </u> 。这种方法类似于将一个人对数字 <u> 依赖 </u> 的 <u> 包裹 </u> 送进 <u> 仓库 </u> 。它要求我们有意地 <u> 删除 </u> 那些不必要的、我们不需要使用的数字应用程序和 <u> 文件 </u> 。在这个过程中，我们要在30天内远离那些 <u> 可有可无的 </u> 线上 <u> 活动 </u> ，从而创造一个 <u> 空白 </u> 空间，让自己能更加专注。30天后，再 <u> 谨慎 </u> 筛选少量能为你所在意的事物带来 <u> 巨大 </u> 价值的线上活动，将其重新纳入生活。

paragraphs.en: In the final chapter of part one, I'll {guide} you through carrying out your own digital declutter.In doing so, I'll draw on an experiment I ran in 2018 in which over 1,600 people {agreed} to perform a digital declutter.You'll hear these {participants} 'stories and learn what {strategies} worked well for them, and what traps they encountered that you should avoid.
paragraphs.cn: 在第一部分的最后一章，我将 <u> 指导 </u> 你进行自己的数字清理。在此过程中，我将结合我在2018年进行的一项实验，其中超过1600人 <u> 同意 </u> 进行数字清理。你将听到这些 <u> 参与者 </u> 的故事，了解哪些 <u> 策略 </u> 对他们有效，以及他们遇到的、你应该避免的陷阱。

paragraphs.en: The second part of this book takes a closer look at some ideas that will help you cultivate ( (培养) ) a {sustainable} digital minimalism lifestyle.In these chapters, I examine issues such as the importance of solitude ( (独处) ) and the {necessity} of cultivating {high-quality} {leisure} to {replace} the time {most} people now spent on {mindless} device use.Each chapter concludes with a {collection} of practices, which are {designed} to help you act on the big ideas of the chapter.You can view these practices as a {toolbox} meant to {aid} your {efforts} to build a {minimalist} lifestyle that works for your particular circumstances.
paragraphs.cn: 本书的第二部分深入探讨了一些有助于你培养 <u> 可持续的 </u> 数字极简主义生活方式的理念。在这些章节中，我探讨了一些问题，如独处的重要性，以及用 <u> 高质量休闲 </u> 方式来 <u> 取代 </u> 当下 <u> 大多数人无意识 </u> 刷手机的必要性。每章结尾都有一 <u> 系列 </u> 实践方法，这些方法 <u> 旨在 </u> 帮助你将本章的主要理念付诸行动。你可以将这些实践方法视为一个 <u> 工具箱 </u> ，它能 <u> 帮助 </u> 你 <u> 努力 </u> 建立一种适合你自身特定情况的 <u> 极简 </u> 生活方式。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP+Fxyt/ox+WDCb+dhfH7KaYaJ4u5RsVmLondVmcHiLum9J1BQErGzJvzqa5GEIz4ZA==
